domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 用于表达系统性能或极限状态与随机输入关系的函数。
usage_overview: 性能函数将结构响应与承载或位移限值联系起来，用于表达随机输入下的性能状态，并作为统计矩计算的对象，以描述其随机变化特征。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: With the emphasis on and deepened understanding of the reliability analysis, moment method has long surfaced as an important approach to reliability simulation, and could minimize the function simula-tions and find an appropriate probability distribution of the performance function.
For example, a certain kind of linearization coefficients may provide different values in multi dimensions when the performance function is nonlinear.
